title: Patient Bed and Ward Transfer Procedure
content:
SOP: Patient Bed and Ward Transfer Procedure (SOP-TRF-001)
DEPARTMENT: Admission and Discharge
VERSION: 1.5
ROLES: admission, nurse, doctor
PURPOSE: Intra-hospital patient transfers and HIS bed state tracking.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Patient Bed and Ward Transfer Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Patient Bed and Ward Transfer Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Patient Bed and Ward Transfer Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Patient Bed and Ward Transfer Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Patient Bed and Ward Transfer Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Admission and Discharge.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-TRF-001 Patient Bed and Ward Transfer Procedure v1.5, Section 4
